integrity: The source theorem, its hypotheses, and its two quotient outcomes were checked in the full primary text. The source's first public date and primary MSC were checked on the arXiv record. The uniform theory construction and the Pi_2/Sigma_2 completeness reductions were reconstructed directly from the standard computation predicate; no finite experiment is used.
scientific_limitations: The result concerns unary program composition and a deliberately constructed uniform family of recursively enumerable extensions of PA. It classifies the least generated composition congruence, not the unrepaired pointwise relation, and does not assert the same index-set presentation for arbitrary enumerations of theories.
title: The minimal composition repair has a \(\Pi^0_2\)-complete two-point spectrum
